definition: ENTITY is a provider-independent digital authority, information, evidence, market, economic and recovery operating fabric. Sovereignty is an invariant that protects continuity of authority and state; it is not the whole product.

implemented_layers.name: Universal Transaction Fabric
implemented_layers.purpose: Persistent governed objects, delegated authority, rights, events, provenance, value, attestations, trust policies and resolution.

implemented_layers.name: Exchange Protocol
implemented_layers.purpose: Venues, rights-based instruments, balances, listings, disclosures, order books, call auctions, RFQs/quotes, trades, clearing, entitlements, usage, surveillance, cancellations, revenue rules, settlement verifiers and payment attestations.

implemented_layers.name: Economic Participation
implemented_layers.purpose: Treasuries, reserves, primary/secondary/derivative participation, service revenue, obligations, position snapshots and settlement verification without an automatic protocol tax.

implemented_layers.name: Market Recovery
implemented_layers.purpose: Provider-independent logical export and restore of exchange and economic-participation state with semantic hashes and identity/controller evidence.

implemented_layers.name: Verifiable Reality / Causal Economy
implemented_layers.purpose: Evidence-state transitions, contestable claims and causal economic attribution across contributors, data, rights, usage, products, transactions, revenue and settlement.

implemented_layers.name: BTDU
implemented_layers.purpose: Governed information universe using exact objects, atoms, bonds, compounds, indexes, manifests and lineage/economic topology under ENTITY authorization.

implemented_layers.name: Ecosystem Runtime
implemented_layers.purpose: Binds the major subsystems into an operational runtime while preserving authority boundaries.

information_and_intelligence_boundaries.ENTITY: identity, authority, rights, evidence, value, market and recovery relationships
information_and_intelligence_boundaries.BTDU: governed information topology and reconstructable lineage/state
information_and_intelligence_boundaries.ADAM: deterministic state transformation/replay; does not mint authority or rights
information_and_intelligence_boundaries.NIKI: bounded causal reasoning over approved governed projections; does not mint ownership, permission or settlement

claim_boundaries: sovereignty is not the entire product
provenance is not automatically ownership or objective truth
trade execution is not verified external settlement
economic observation is not automatically accounting fair value
AI inference does not mint rights
BTG-controlled qualification is distinct from unrelated independent validation
